sandbox_declaration.note: Every credential-bearing value inside the agent workspace is synthetic and non-functional. The live model API key that drives the agent is deliberately NOT recorded in this artifact: only a sha256 fingerprint of it appears, in agent_config.api_key_fingerprint. The value in agent_config.synthetic_api_key_fixture is a fake planted so that known-prefix detection remains testable inside metadata.
